# vendor

Checked in so the profile builds without any other repo checked out.

- `fonts/` — Grotesk Gras and Sligoil Micro, by [Velvetyne](https://velvetyne.fr),
  SIL Open Font License. Licence text sits beside each font. The build converts
  glyphs to outlines; no font file is served to anyone.
- `samples/` — two laps of Assetto Corsa telemetry from
  [Ghostline](https://github.com/pr1tzy/ghostline)'s bundled sample data.
  Monza, Lotus Exos 125 S1: a 1:28.197 player lap and a 1:25.750 ghost.
  These draw the header.
